attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1-3) with an appdb.orders table holding application data, then added node4 as a fourth full member that received the existing data via SST and accepted writes like the other members. All four nodes were then individually restarted per the mandatory protocol, with each node's boot identity verified to change and full cluster health/data/quorum verified to recover before moving to the next node.
